title: Csatlakozás az Európai Unióhoz és a Schengeni övezethez (EU Accession & the Schengen Borderless Zone)
grammar: Constitutional Guarantees, Supranational Integration & Kin-State Registers in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say when Hungary joined the European Union and what the four freedoms are.
I can explain what the Schengen area changed at the borders.
I can say how the Erasmus programme and EU funds help people in Hungary.
I can use the words of this lesson about the EU and Schengen.
